US Department of Homeland Security issues fines to illegal immigrants. Undocumented migrants are getting fined as much as $1.8 million. US President Donald Trump's government has issued fines to over 103,000 people. The Trump administration hopes that the fine will convince migrants to self-deport. Hem Saroya tells you more.
